operation.input: A finite carrier C, a declared surjection q:C->Q, and a proposition region S subset C
output: Descends(T), with the unique T subset Q satisfying S=q^{-1}(T)
NonSaturated(c,c'), with q(c)=q(c') and exactly one of c,c' in S

applicability: C and Q are finite and explicitly indexed
q has matching arity and is onto consecutive quotient labels
S is an explicit region on C

witness.Descends: The quotient mask T and exact round-trip equality q^{-1}(T)=S
witness.NonSaturated: A same-fibre pair with unequal S membership

refusal: Any claimed Descends result whose pullback differs from S
replay: Scan each q-fibre for constant membership; if constant, assemble the unique quotient mask and pull it back; otherwise return the first differing pair in index order.
tested_reuse: Three-point square observation quotient with fibres {0,1},{2}
comparison_boundary: An unchecked direct image maps singleton {0} to a quotient class whose pullback is a larger set; the gate refuses the same input with a concrete fibre witness. No speedup claim is made.
residual: This term authorizes only proposition descent. It does not merge semantic identities, construct a quotient program, choose an exact lift, create a native certificate, or establish free, Close, M6 closure, hypothesized arithmetic truth, or arithmetic universality.
